name: SciCrunch_resolve_rrid
description: Resolve any Research Resource Identifier (RRID) via SciCrunch's registry: software/tools (SCR_ prefix), cell lines, model organisms, and plasmids, plus a general fallback for any other RRID. Example: rrid='SCR_002526' (Stereo Investigator software) returns its name, description, and proper citation. For antibody RRIDs (AB_ prefix), AntibodyRegistry_resolve_rrid gives richer antibody-specific fields (target, clonality, host organism).

rrid.description: RRID with or without prefix, e.g. 'SCR_002526' or 'RRID:SCR_002526'.
